name: Fire & Flour
facts:
Fire & Flour is a wood-fired restaurant at 214 Ember Street, Brooklyn, NY. Phone (555) 014-2290.
Cuisine: Neapolitan-style pizza baked 90 seconds at 900°F, oak-fired grill, sourdough baked in-house every morning. Dough is fermented 48 hours. Vegetables come from two farms within 80 miles.
Hours: Monday to Thursday 12:00-22:00, Friday and Saturday 12:00-23:00, Sunday 11:00-21:00 (brunch from 11:00). Kitchen closes 30 minutes before closing.
Reservations: book on the website (#book); confirmation by text within 15 minutes. No deposit, no card. Free cancellation up to 2 hours before. Booking online gets free house sourdough & dip. Walk-ins welcome, bar seats always kept free; Friday/Saturday evenings are usually full.
Offer: Pizza Tuesday, 2 pizzas + a bottle of house wine for $45, dine-in only.
Groups: private room up to 40 guests, set menus from $35 per person. Groups over 10: choose 11+ in the form or call.
Menu, pizza: Margherita $15 (V), Smoked Pepperoni with hot honey $18 (best seller), Fennel Sausage & Chili $19, Truffle Bianca $21 (V), Garden $16 (V), Kids' cheese pizza $9 (under 12). Gluten-free base +$3.
Grill: Fire-Roast Half Chicken $24 (GF), Chicken Souvlaki $19, Ribeye 12 oz dry-aged $38 (GF), Grilled Seabass $29 (GF).
Burgers & wraps: Ember Burger $17, Crispy Chicken Burger $16, Halloumi Burger $15 (V), Shawarma Wrap $14.
Starters & salads: House Sourdough & Dip $7 (free when booking online), Roasted Butternut Soup $9 (V, GF), Oven Wings $12, Charred Bean & Feta $13 (V, GF).
Desserts: Nutella Calzone $10, Burnt Basque Cheesecake $9 (GF), Affogato $7 (GF).
Diet: several vegetarian options; gluten-free base available but the kitchen handles flour so no guarantee for celiac guests. Staff can adapt dishes for allergies; tell us in the booking note.
Kids: high chairs available, kids' pizza $9.
Takeaway: order by phone, ready in about 20 minutes. No delivery.
Access: street parking, subway 4 minutes away.
rules: Do not take bookings yourself: send visitors to the booking form or the phone number. Never confirm a table is available.

ui.title: Fire & Flour assistant
ui.greeting: Hi! 👋 I can help with the menu, opening hours, allergies or group bookings. What would you like to know?
ui.teaser: 👋 Hungry? Ask me about tonight's menu or a table for the weekend.

cta.label: 📅 Book a table, free bread included

ui.fallback: Good question! I don't have that detail. Call us at (555) 014-2290 or leave a note in the booking form and the team will answer.
ui.disclaimer: Automated assistant. For bookings, use the form or call.

faq.a: We're open Mon to Thu 12:00-22:00, Fri & Sat 12:00-23:00 and Sunday 11:00-21:00 (brunch from 11). The kitchen closes 30 minutes before. Want to book a table?

You can book in 30 seconds with the form on this page; we text you a confirmation within 15 minutes, and booking online gets you free house bread & dip. No deposit, free cancellation up to 2 h before.

Plenty of vegetarian choices: Margherita, Truffle Bianca, Garden pizza, Halloumi Burger, soup and salads. Any pizza can be gluten-free for +$3, but our kitchen handles flour, so no guarantee for celiac guests. Mention allergies in your booking note.
Our private room seats up to 40 guests, with set menus from $35 per person. Choose "11+" in the booking form or call (555) 014-2290 and we'll plan it with you.
Pizza Tuesday: 2 pizzas + a bottle of house wine for $45 (dine-in). And when you book online, the house sourdough & dip is free.
Pizzas are $15 to $21, burgers $15 to $17, grill dishes $19 to $38, desserts $7 to $10. Our best seller is the Smoked Pepperoni with hot honey ($18).
Families are very welcome: high chairs, a kids' cheese pizza for $9, and kids love watching the oven.
Takeaway yes: call (555) 014-2290 and it's ready in about 20 minutes. We don't do delivery.
We're at 214 Ember Street, Brooklyn, NY. Street parking nearby, and the subway is a 4-minute walk.
